entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Apparently Eiko has started dating[n]a host from a club near her work.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I guess he, um... hit on her one day[n]after her shift, and that was that.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Since then, he's the only thing she'll[n]talk about. She even sent me a picture[n]of their date at Destinyland.
Are you jealous of them?
That's annoying.
He sounds suspicious.[clr 27]

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: It's not a problem as long as[n]she's happy...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: But knowing the line of work her[n]boyfriend is in, I'm worried that[n]he might be deceiving her.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Honestly, it's difficult to have[n]that reaction seeing how happy[n]they were in that picture...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: But knowing the line of work her[n]boyfriend is in, I'm worried that[n]he might be deceiving her.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: ...You think so as well?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: For now it seems he hasn't forced[n]her to spend any money at his club,[n]but I'm still nervous...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Beyond that, he calls her his "princess"[n]and constantly tells her how special she[n]is. It makes me sick to my stomach.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: But Eiko refuses to listen to me.[n]She said the idea that all hosts[n]are bad people is outdated...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: She even said she was shocked to be[n]getting advice from someone who would[n]"totally flunk a test about love."

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Tests about love aren't a thing[n]though... and even if they were, I[n]most certainly wouldn't flunk them!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: S-Sorry about that.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I'm probably just being biased[n]towards him. I mean, I don't have[n]any proof that he's untrustworthy...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: But that's why I want to meet him[n]and find out for myself what kind[n]of person he really is.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: And... if it's not too much to ask,[n]I'd like you to accompany me on[n]this excursion as well.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: This time, um... you'll have to play the[n]role of my boyfriend.
I got this.[clr 27]
Why do I have to do it?
Only if I can take it seriously.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: It's honestly okay? You're so reliable,[n][fName]-kun.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: You're the only person I'd be[n]comfortable asking about this.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: How do you mean?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Oh, I see. You're seriously[n]worried about Eiko too.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: That's very kind of you.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I think if I have a boyfriend, Eiko might[n]be more inclined to listen to me.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: To tell you the truth... I actually already[n]made plans with her and her boyfriend[n]for a double date.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: S-Sorry.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: But it's just going to be at a diner.[n]Nothing particularly fancy, I promise.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Thank you! You're a tremendous help.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I'm so glad you agreed to this.[n]I don't know who else I'd have[n]asked if you had said no...
I can sense Makoto's trust in me...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Eiko... I hope she's not getting herself[n]wrapped up in anything dangerous.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: But just in case, I'll try looking[n]for some info on that host.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Well, see you later.
